script: Isso acabou de acontecer na ciência e tecnologia: NASA Data Clinches First-of-Its-Kind Stellar Merger. De acordo com relatórios publicados pela NASA News, os novos dados confirmam: Researchers recently identified a first of its kind: A star slightly less massive than the Sun spiraled into and merged with a puffy supergiant star at the outskirts of our neighboring Andromeda galaxy. They nicknamed the newly single, potentially “rejuvenated” star Bao. Their NASA-funded discovery was then bolstered by quick-turn observations from NASA’s James Webb […].
